response_facts is a truthful observation, not an arbitrary caller claim. body_ref resolves only a fixed private intent/attempt content-addressed member via anchored descriptors, no input path. captured_body_bytes<=observed_body_bytes<=65537. A bounded one-byte over-limit detector may observe65537 while retaining a clearly labelled65536-byte prefix; body_complete=false/body_limit then. A limit hit, partial read, missing EOF, malformed framing or incomplete headers is never complete. Body refs never label an observed prefix as a complete server original.
